title: Can I BEAT The Dragon Bishop? (Rare Variant)
summary: chess.com 'Dragon Bishop' variant: both bishops are replaced by Dragon Bishops that move like a bishop plus a knight that CANNOT jump (blocked by an adjacent piece in the leg direction), and the back rank is randomly shuffled (960-style). He wins three games and a fourth bonus game.
rules: Bishops are replaced by Dragon Bishops: bishop moves + knight moves, but the knight move is non-leaping (blocked if the orthogonally adjacent 'leg' square is occupied - he shows red/allowed vs blocked squares at 0:01, 4:27).
Back rank pieces are randomly arranged like Chess960 (0:34).
Dragons can change square colour via knight moves.
Otherwise normal chess (castling exists: 5:09 long castle).
